metadata.scope: All 150 rows and all eight columns of the Jokers list table. Individual Joker pages are not included.
metadata.image_rights: Image URLs reference the source wiki assets; consult the original file pages for image-specific rights.

field_notes.number: Collection number from the source table, not an internal game ID.
field_notes.effect: Source wording, with HTML removed and whitespace normalized; meaningful line breaks use newline characters.
field_notes.effect_notes: Explanatory tooltips in the effect cell.
field_notes.cost: Listed shop cost in in-game dollars; null when the source displays N/A.
field_notes.base_cost: Numeric cost, including the $20 hidden sort value shown in the Legendary cost tooltip.
field_notes.unlock_notes: Explanatory tooltips in the unlock requirement cell.
field_notes.type: Expanded category name from the source link; type_symbol preserves the table symbol.
field_notes.activation: Source activation label with Indep. expanded to Independent; null means the source cell is empty; N/A is preserved as a string.
field_notes.image: Absolute original and thumbnail URLs, not embedded image bytes; dimensions are in pixels.
